**Mi Band 7 / 8 / 9:** use `mi-band-192x490.png` as the background and put the clock inside
the screen: x 47, y 99, 103 × 99 px.

## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.3968 (spec 0.3982), screen at the exact 96:92 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://static-mpm-optimized.s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/2245bfa1-bb80-48d1-885b-aec907396f7c_xlarge.png (Mobile Phone Museum, phone-detail/cmd-j70; no press render found)) by Mobile Phone Museum; geometry measured on a [photo](https://www.mobilephonemuseum.com/phone-detail/cmd-j70) by Mobile Phone Museum; specs: [gsmchoice.com](https://www.gsmchoice.com/en/catalogue/sony/cmdj70/), [mobilecollectors.net](https://mobilecollectors.net/phones/sony-cmd-j70).
